import pandas as pd

gold = pd.read_csv("review_gold.csv").set_index("review_id")["label"]

def majority(row):

    return counts.index[0] if counts.iloc[0] >= 2 else None

n_recheck=int((wide.drop(columns=worst).nunique(axis=1)>1).sum())

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score
wide = pd.read_csv("review_labels.csv").pivot(index="review_id", columns="annotator", values="label")

def kappa(x, y):
    x, y = list(x), list(y)
    pass


def kappa(x,y):
    x,y=list(x),list(y)
    po=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(x,y))/len(x)
    pe=sum(x.count(k)/len(x)*y.count(k)/len(y) for k in set(x)|set(y))
    return (po-pe)/(1-pe)
kappa_ab=round(kappa(wide["аня"],wide["борис"]),3)
kappa_av=round(kappa(wide["аня"],wide["вика"]),3)
print(kappa_ab,cohen_kappa_score(wide["аня"],wide["борис"]))
